summary: Customer requests replayable SIEM export with per-session context, RBAC-derived actor attributes, deterministic event IDs, and monthly eDiscovery evidence bundle
description:
Issue summary:
FinTrust Bank has requested a SIEM export format that is replayable for legal eDiscovery: each event must include a stable per-session context envelope (session_id, login_method, auth_provider, session_start_ts), RBAC-derived actor attributes (roles hash, effective_entitlements), and deterministic event_id values so the customer can reconcile server-side logs with downstream SIEM ingestion. They also want a monthly evidence bundle (calendar-month ZIP) with manifest and chainable resume tokens for incremental replay and a proof-of-rotation statement for the HMAC key used to sign manifests.

Impact:
- FinTrust is preparing for an audit / litigation hold and cannot accept our current export because nested request fragments lack session provenance and event IDs are non-deterministic across retries.
- Without deterministic IDs and a replayable envelope, their compliance team cannot produce a canonical audit trail for eDiscovery.

Environment:
- Production export (customer tenant fintrust-prod) delivered to customer Sumo Logic HTTP endpoint via the Redwood SIEM Bridge.
- Tenant is on enterprise plan with private networking and allowlist.

Desired deliverables from Redwood:
1) A new export envelope option (named "session_replay_envelope_v1") that includes: session_id, session_start_ts, session_ttl, auth_provider, login_method, actor_attributes.{role_list_hash,effective_entitlements}, request_chain (list of upstream service IDs), and deterministic event_id computed as sha256(tenant_id || "|" || session_id || "|" || request_uuid || "|" || canonical_timestamp) truncated to 32 hex chars.
2) Hourly incremental manifest files with HMAC-SHA256 signatures and key-rotation metadata suitable for legal evidence.
3) Monthly evidence bundle (calendar month) containing all manifests, a single concatenated ndjson extract, a verification guide, and an HSM attestation summary for the signing key rotation.
4) Sample ingestion mapping for Sumo Logic (HEC) showing how to map the envelope into fields and an opinionated deduplication strategy on downstream that uses deterministic event_id.

Steps to reproduce (customer validation flow):
1. Enable "session_replay_envelope_v1" for tenant fintrust-prod via Console -> Audit Exports -> Format.
2. Trigger multiple identical requests (retries) from their app to generate duplicate request_uuids with same session_id.
3. Verify that exported events to Sumo show identical deterministic event_id for logically identical records and that session fields are present.

Logs / attachments:
- Customer attached sample ndjson showing missing session_id and request fragments (attachment: fintrust_sample_missing_session.ndjson).
- Customer provided legal spec: FinTrust_eDiscovery_Manifest_Requirements_v2.pdf.

Notes: This request touches audit export schema, signing/manifest pipeline, and auth/identity enrichment. They require an implementation plan and a test window before the end of month to validate the evidence bundle for March 2026.

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 - SRE: Confirmed current pipeline produces non-deterministic uuids; deterministic IDs can be produced if we canonicalize timestamp and include session_id+request_uuid. Need to evaluate performance impact on high-throughput tenants.

2026-03-10 - Identity: RBAC store (authz-service) can return effective_entitlements snapshot per session if we capture role resolution at auth time. Suggested adding a small caching layer to avoid per-request authz queries for export path.

2026-03-11 - Engineering: Draft design saved at https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/468210. Prototype PR targeting siem-bridge will add envelope and deterministic-id generation (see related PRs).

2026-03-11 - Legal/Compliance consult: HSM attestation language needs to reference key rotation epochs and provide an ordered manifest with resume tokens to prove continuity for eDiscovery chain-of-custody.
resolution: Planned: Implement session_replay_envelope_v1 as opt-in export format. Add deterministic event_id generation to export pipeline and include per-hour manifests with hmac signatures and key-rotation metadata. Provide sample mapping and a verification checklist for FinTrust.

Workarounds provided: Customer can temporarily enable per-request 'debug_envelope' (adds session_id where available) and use our existing manifest files to hand-assemble monthly bundles; however this is manual and will not satisfy deterministic-id requirement for dedupe.

Next steps: Engineering to open feature branch and schedule a short staging window for FinTrust the week of 2026-03-15. SRE to calculate throughput impact and prepare rollout playbook. Support to follow up with customer to schedule validation window.
